Launchpad is a fully funded business support programme delivered across South Yorkshire, that brings together a wide range of start-up services including workshops, events and one to one support from business advisors and coaches.  It is a fully inclusive programme designed to help ambitious entrepreneurs set up and run successful businesses and support SMEs under 3 years old, and micro businesses of any age, to take the next step and grow their business.

Launchpad is supported and part funded by the South Yorkshire Mayoral Combined Authority (SYMCA) and the UK Shared Prosperity Fund (UKSPF).  Launchpad is managed by the award winning team at Enterprising Barnsley, BMBC and delivered in partnership with the City of Doncaster Council, Sheffield City Council, and Rotherham MBC.
